page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench scores, and static web serving throughput fall within the average range. However, memory performance shows limitations; uncached large-block read and write memory bandwidth tests, along with Passmark memory and database operations, score in the bottom 25%.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and strong single-core performance, this instance is suitable for memory-intensive applications that do not require high-speed local storage or extreme memory write bandwidth. Appropriate workloads include in-memory caching, Redis deployments, and general-purpose web serving. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, and the weak uncached memory bandwidth should be factored into memory-heavy database planning.
